value.draft: A listing shows a minimum age to ensure the safety and efficacy of the intervention for the target population. It also meets regulatory requirements for participant eligibility and helps align the study design with the appropriate group of participants. Setting a minimum age ensures that the study includes individuals who are likely to benefit from the treatment and can safely participate. This helps maintain the integrity of the trial and supports accurate results.
